start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher hoon. Aaj perimeter seekhenge. Aap bataiye, rectangle ka perimeter kis cheez ko naapta hai?

turns.reply: Kabir, yeh sawaal sach mein irritating lag sakta hai; perimeter bas boundary ke chaaron taraf ki total length hoti hai. Aap rectangle ki boundary ko ungli se trace karke bataiye.
